summary: Master the art of handling employee disputes and managing underperformance with our comprehensive training course. Equip yourself for success in the workplace.
lede: Managing underperformance and employee disputes helps managers and HR professionals address performance concerns and workplace conflict. The course develops practical skills in setting expectations, diagnosing causes, and holding respectful feedback conversations, then applying improvement plans, documenting decisions, and handling grievances through neutral listening and mediation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly deal with staff performance, behavior, or workplace conflict.
audience: HR professionals and employee relations officers
People and culture or talent development professionals
modules: Managing Emotions, Stress, and Personal Biases
Building a High-Performance and Fair Workplace Culture
prerequisites: Participants should have some experience in team management or HR roles. A basic understanding of organizational structures and employee management is recommended.
